cites: The Lord of the Rings, The Passing Of The Grey Company
notes: “They passed Tarlang’s Neck and came into Lamedon; and the Shadow Host pressed behind and fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin away in the West behind them.” — The Lord of the Rings, The Passing Of The Grey Company
indexed by Christopher Tolkien as: Pass between the White Mountains and an outlying spur, west of Kiril
unplaced: no containing realm has been established — searched under C582. It is a saddle, which cannot run through anything: “Pass between the White Mountains and an outlying spur, west of Kiril” (HoME VIII index). Passing it brings a traveller INTO Lamedon (LotR V.9), so it is the threshold and not a thing within.
